description.value: Namaste Indian Cuisine is a sit-down Indian restaurant founded in 2010 on Douglas Street in downtown Victoria, drawing on regional cuisines from across India — from fiery northern curries to coastal southern dishes. The menu is broad, spanning tandoor specialties, biryanis, and Indo-Chinese fusion alongside a large vegetarian selection, with many items labeled gluten-free. Carryout is available, making it a practical mid-ride fuel stop in the heart of the city.

address.value: 2950 Douglas St unit -280, Victoria, BC V8T 4N4

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is live and corroborates the OSM phone number and location; the contact page confirms the address as 2950 Douglas St unit -280, Victoria, BC V8T 4N4 and phone (250) 744-3330. The menu page uses a 'Carryout' label confirming takeout availability, and menu categories (Veg Curries, Veg Tandoori) plus individual GF labels on multiple items confirm vegetarian and GF options. No mention of bike parking, washrooms, water refill, or Wi-Fi anywhere on the site.
concerns: Menu page header displays a different phone number (604-951-0037, a Lower Mainland area code) vs. (250) 744-3330 on all other pages and in OSM — likely an online-ordering system number, but worth verifying.
OSM addr:unit tag is '280' while the website consistently shows 'unit -280' (possibly a below-grade or basement unit); minor discrepancy.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active Indian restaurant in downtown Victoria with a live website, confirmed address, and carryout service — straightforwardly useful to touring cyclists.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Dedicated menu categories 'Veg Curries' and 'Veg Tandoori'; numerous individual items labeled GF (e.g. Fish Pakora, Chicken Pakora, Paneer Pakora, Onion Bhajia, Gobhi Garlic)
